## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->

transparent-openapi-mcp is a lightweight MCP server that maps OpenAPI v3 specifications one‑to‑one onto MCP tools, allowing the server to stay unchanged when the spec changes. It runs in a container, reads a configuration file that points to OpenAPI specs and back‑ends, and automatically generates the corresponding tool definitions. This makes it easy to integrate any OpenAPI‑defined service with Claude Code by simply providing the spec and endpoint configuration. Developers can quickly prototype and deploy a fully functional MCP without writing custom code, just by mounting their config and running the image.
